searchText: Hi there from Germany, I want to take unexplained noise from human behavior experiment and generate random values from it. I'm a applied behavioral scientist working in inclusion and diversity. And always on the lookout for fun new creative projects that use interdisciplinary knowledge from new angles. 🙂
